Name: SearchScopeCS
Title: Search Scope CodeSystem
Description: Valid locations within a FHIR Search Result where resources are found. Used by ViewJoinMap to specify where to look for pivot and joined resources.

Name: ViewTypeCS
Title: UI Component Types (example)
Description: **Example** vocabulary of view types. Each code names a kind of UI component used to render a piece of FHIR-derived data; a ViewConfig binds to one of these codes to select its component. View types are implementer-defined — a player provides its own CodeSystem rather than reusing these codes. The mapping from a code to a concrete renderer is the player's own implementation detail.
